onb_name.says: Hi, I'm Pencil! What's your name? Ask a grown-up to type it.

onb_age.says: Nice to meet you! How old are you? Tap your birthday cake.

onb_colour.says: Now pick my colour! Which one do you like?

coach_hunt.says: Tap every one you can find!

coach_fix.says: Tap the ones that are wrong!

coach_feed.says: Drag the right pictures to the monster!

coach_feed_boss.says: Tap the snacks the boss can eat!

coach_baskets.says: Drag each picture to the right basket!

coach_baskets_boss.says: Tap the right pile for each one!

coach_match.says: Tap two cards to find a pair!

coach_order.says: Tap them in the right order!

coach_truth.says: Is it true? Tap thumbs up. Is it silly? Tap thumbs down.

coach_truth_boss.says: Is it true? Tap the sun. Is it silly? Tap the moon.

coach_connect.says: Tap the dots in A B C order!

coach_sounds_tap.says: Tap each dot under the word!

coach_sounds_slide.says: Now slide the arrow to read the word!

coach_sounds_pick.says: Which picture is it? Tap it!

coach_trace.says: Start at the blue dot. Follow the arrow!

coach_write.says: Write it on the lines. Then tap Done!

coach_flash.says: Look at it. It will hide. Then write it!
